facebook.content:
Family — Our homes are under attack, yet the Kingdom calls us to stand firm in love and truth.  

Lord, we declare Your authority over every household.  We bind any spirit of division and release the peace of Christ that surpasses understanding.  Let Your Word be the foundation, and let each member walk in the purpose You have placed upon them.  May Your covenant love reign in every conversation and decision.  

If you stand with this declaration, drop a 🙏.  Share your own prayer need below.
